description: This file defines the StaffRepositoryWrapper class, which provides methods for accessing and handling Staff entities with additional error checking and exception handling, acting as a utility or helper layer around the StaffRepository.

classes.name: StaffRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for StaffRepository providing null checks and exception handling for Staff data access operations.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Fetches a Staff by ID, throws StaffNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: findByOfficeWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Finds a Staff by staffId and officeId, throws StaffNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: findByOfficeHierarchyWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Finds a Staff by staffId and hierarchy string, ensuring the hierarchy starts with the staff's office hierarchy, throws StaffNotFoundException if not matching.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the Staff entity via the repository.
